What it does

Built for Short-form creators, video editors, YouTubers, channel strategists, social media managers and agencies doing competitor research.

  1. 01

    Outlier score

    Views divided by the creator's median. Breakouts float to the top, whatever the channel size.

  2. 02

    YouTube scanner

    Benchmarks long-form videos and Shorts against the channel median and sorts by multiplier.

  3. 03

    Reels insights

    Engagement metrics for Reels on Explore and creator profiles.

  4. 04

    One-click export

    Excel or CSV, or paste formatted rows straight into Google Sheets, Notion or Airtable.

  5. 05

    Reel transcripts

    Turns spoken audio into timestamped or plain-text transcripts with your own Groq key.
